auth.loginText: Sign in with your university account.
auth.deactivated: Your account is deactivated. Please contact an administrator.
auth.invalidAffiliation: Your account is no longer entitled to use this portal.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.topKeysDescription: Spend per key in the period
dashboard.topModelsDescription: Spend per model in the period
dashboard.byProviderDescription: Requests, tokens and spend per provider
dashboard.noKeyHint: You have no API key yet. Create your first key now.
dashboard.keysBlocked: Blocked ({{count}}): {{names}}. The budget is exhausted or you are no longer a member of the cost center.
dashboard.keysExpired: Expired ({{count}}): {{names}}. Extend the keys under API keys.
dashboard.costCentersDescription: Cost centers you can create keys on

keys.title: API keys
keys.subtitle: Manage your API keys
keys.name: Name
keys.deleteConfirm: Really delete key “{{name}}”? Its spend stays in reports.
keys.secretHint: This key is shown only once. Copy it now.
keys.budgetHint: Optional, amount in EUR. The sum of all key budgets must not exceed your user budget.
keys.budgetPeriodHint: Monthly: the budget applies per month and starts again afterwards. No time window: the budget applies once for the key's whole lifetime.
keys.paidRequiresCostCenter: Paid models require an approved cost center.
keys.createHint: Choose a name, cost center and models or providers. The key is shown once after creation.
keys.empty: No keys yet. Create your first key.
keys.extendHint: Extend lifetime by 6 months from now
keys.selectModel: Please select at least one model or provider.
keys.providersHint: The key gets all current models of the provider. New models of the provider are added automatically.

keyTest.title: Test key
keyTest.subtitle: Send a short prompt to check that an API key works
keyTest.cardDescription: The key is passed to LiteLLM for this test only and is not stored. The request is billed to the key like any other.
keyTest.keyHint: Paste the full key as it was shown when it was created.
keyTest.noModels: No models are enabled for this key.
keyTest.promptHint: At most 2000 characters. The answer is limited to a short length.
keyTest.defaultPrompt: Answer in one short sentence: does the connection work?

requests.title: Usage
requests.subtitle: Your own requests from the LiteLLM logs

profile.title: Profile
profile.costCenterInvalid: The cost center must consist of 8 digits.
profile.cardDescription: Name and e-mail come from Keycloak. The language can be changed here.

costCenters.title: Cost centers
costCenters.name: Name
costCenters.adminSubtitle: Maintain the lookup and handle requests
costCenters.mySubtitle: Cost centers for which you manage members, max budget and report
costCenters.createHint: Newly created cost centers are approved immediately.
costCenters.maxBudgetHint: Amount in EUR. Leave empty for unlimited.
costCenters.modelsHint: Without a selection all models are released, including future ones. With a selection only the chosen ones; a provider checkbox selects all current models of the provider. Paid models are only available on own cost centers, not on the default cost center.
costCenters.ownerHint: A LiteLLM user. They automatically become cost center admin and stay admin while they are the owner.
costCenters.ownerRequired: Please select an owner from LiteLLM.

providers.title: Models
providers.subtitle: Models from LiteLLM, tier and display names
providers.priceHint: EUR per 1M tokens, as configured in LiteLLM
providers.noProviderHint: LiteLLM reports no provider for this model. It is not added automatically to keys that use a whole provider. Add it in LiteLLM with a prefix, e.g. openai/gpt-5.
providers.noProviderBanner: Models without a detected provider: {{count}}. They are not added automatically to keys that use a whole provider. Add the model in LiteLLM with a prefix (e.g. openai/gpt-5) and sync again.

users.title: Users / roles
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate user “{{name}}”? Login and all keys will be blocked.
users.subtitle: Roles, cost center admins, budgets and deactivation
users.budgetHint: At 100 % all keys of the user are blocked. Project budgets have a fixed start and end.
users.costCenterAdminHint: The user may set the max budget and view reports for the selected cost centers.
users.impersonateConfirm: Act as “{{name}}” on your current session? Everything you do until you stop is done in their name and is audited.

reports.title: Budget usage
reports.subtitle: Budget and spend per cost center

cost_center.block: Cost center budget exhausted, keys blocked

help.title: Help
help.description: Quick guide for the current screen

errors.COST_CENTER_DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE: The default cost center cannot be changed.
errors.COST_CENTER_REQUEST_PENDING: There is already a pending request.
errors.COST_CENTER_NOT_MEMBER: You are not a member of this cost center. Please contact a cost center admin.
errors.COST_CENTER_MEMBER_EXISTS: This person is already a member of the cost center.
errors.COST_CENTER_JOIN_REQUEST_PENDING: You already have an open join request for this cost center.
errors.COST_CENTER_OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner of the cost center can appoint, demote or remove cost center admins.
errors.COST_CENTER_OWNER_MUST_BE_ADMIN: The owner stays cost center admin. Set another owner first.
errors.OWNER_NOT_LITELLM_USER: The owner must be a LiteLLM user with an e-mail address.
errors.PAID_MODEL_REQUIRES_COST_CENTER: Paid models require a dedicated cost center.
errors.KEY_BUDGET_EXCEEDS_USER_BUDGET: Key budgets exceed the user budget.
errors.KEY_INVALID: The key was rejected. It is invalid, blocked, expired or not enabled for this model.
errors.KEY_TEST_FAILED: LiteLLM could not run the request. Check that the model supports chat and that budget is left.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: The last admin cannot be demoted.
errors.ROLE_MANAGED_BY_IDP: This role is granted via the Keycloak group.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

members.title: Members
members.addHint: Search by e-mail (at least 3 characters) or user ID. Only people LiteLLM already knows can be added. They get an e-mail and can then create keys on this cost center.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the cost center? Their keys on this cost center will be blocked.
members.bulkHint: Paste e-mail addresses separated by comma, semicolon or line break. Entries like “Name <mail@uni-giessen.de>” are recognized too.
members.bulkTooMany: At most {{max}} addresses at once ({{count}} pasted).
members.bulkNotFoundHint: These people have to sign in once or be created in LiteLLM first.

litellmUsers.title: LiteLLM users
litellmUsers.subtitle: Accounts as the LiteLLM proxy knows them (user master)
litellmUsers.hint: LiteLLM is the user master: an account that exists there is adopted with the same ID on its first API-Selfservice login.
litellmUsers.error: LiteLLM did not answer the user list. The configured LITELLM_API_KEY needs proxy admin rights.

joinRequests.title: Cost centers
joinRequests.subtitle: Your cost centers are listed on top. Join further approved cost centers to create API keys on them.
joinRequests.joinHint: The cost center admins of “{{name}}” receive your request by e-mail and decide on it.
